correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration of derangement facets and all subsequence cells; verified signed cellular boundary with d^2=0; exact integral unimodular Smith elimination yields integer boundary ranks (5, 25, 95, 255, 245) for six-letter boundaries, with no nonunit invariant factors. Exact rank-nullity gives reduced free homology Z in degree 3, Z^74 in degree 4, Z^20 in degree 5 and zero elsewhere. Smaller n=2..5 are likewise completely enumerated with exact Smith elimination. Both code and output are embedded; finite-field ranks are independent auxiliary checks, not substitutes for integral proof.

value.rationale: All derangements form a canonical fixed-point-free generating family studied in the adjacent full and complementary injective-word literature. The first alphabet size exhibiting three consecutive positive integral homology dimensions is a natural minimal threshold: sizes 2 to 5 yield at most two nonzero degrees, whereas size 6 has ranks 1,74,20. An exact torsion-free integral classification distinguishes this from numerical Euler counts and gives a nontrivial boundary for conjectures suggested by small instances; no wider pattern is asserted.
